g.text: Which process clocks fit Earth's history and the empty sky?

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555
font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: For Earth origin, a sky-derived lower bound above the orange line conflicts with the observed terrestrial history.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: The common early-start case can use the full cosmic history. Its distance from the frontier is inferred from these bounds.

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #555555

g.text: Capacity-weighted exposure is not elapsed time. No environmental variation or hard-step completion lottery is added.
